correctness.rationale: The difference set {0,1,3} gives unique common lines for pairs of points, so the stipulated graph is Heawood. The induced maximum-degree-one test is equivalent to component size at most two. Independent enumeration reproduced the seven face counts (14,91,322,651,728,392,58), 1121 matching pairs, and a topological ordering of all 2256 nonempty faces across 10150 oriented cover relations. The unmatched masks are 1, 1762, 3428, 4568, 6744, 8064, 9072, 10472, 12160, 13364, 14208, 15232, 15744, 16000. Thus discrete Morse theory gives a CW complex with a single vertex, thirteen 5-cells attaching to the vertex, and no other cells: the integral homotopy assertion follows without a field-to-integers inference.
residual_risks: The optional archived mod-two reduction was not separately replayed; the integral homotopy result depends on the matching, which was replayed.
